record.description: A foldable, portable vocal booth in black, lined on every interior surface with thick egg crate acoustic foam to cut echo and reflections. specs.material: 100% cotton canvas front, 100% polyester mesh back

record.description: A Carhartt men's cap in Musk Green, one size fits all. It has a structured, medium-profile crown with a pre-curved sandwich visor and a Carhartt patch applique on the front. The front is washed cotton canvas and the back is polyester mesh. The sweatband uses Carhartt Force with FastDry technology.

specs.operating_system: Android TV with built-in Google Assistant

A women's retro-style tennis sneaker in black and white, size 8.5 Regular US. It has a leather upper, a traditional lace-up closure, and a soft fabric lining. The rubber outsole features a herringbone tread pattern, and the midsole is fused to the outsole through autoclave construction.

specs.mesh segments: 6 elasticized mesh segments for USB drives

Under Armour women's tote in Hushed Turquoise with Radial Turquoise accents. Features a large main compartment with a zipper closure and wordmark pull, double webbing straps for carrying options, and a highly water-resistant UA Storm finish. Dimensions when full are 20.3" W x 12.6" L x 9.8" H, with a 25 L (1,525 cubic inch) capacity.

specs.features: Sock-like construction, heel pull tab

record.description: A Nike running shoe in size 10.5, the Air Zoom Mariah Flyknit Racer has a Flyknit upper with a sock-like fit and a heel pull tab. It uses Zoom Air cushioning and a rubber outsole. The design is a modern update of the original Air Mariah. Color is not specified in the listing.

specs.included: Hook-and-loop roll, push pins, instruction manual

record.description: A magnetic screen door panel crafted from fine fiberglass mesh, sized at 38 by 81 inches to suit doors up to 36 by 80 inches. Reinforced edges and dense stitching aim to resist tearing, while hook-and-loop fasteners at the middle and bottom help it stay put in breezy conditions. Lets fresh air and sunshine in.

specs.use: Living room, bedroom, nursery, kids room, playroom

record.description: A 5x8 foot teal blue shag rug with a 1.57-inch soft pile for indoor use in living rooms, bedrooms, and kids' rooms. Anti-slip dots on the underside help it stay put on hard floors, and a middle sponge layer adds sound absorption. It arrives vacuum-packed, so give it a few days to relax before use.

specs.style: Henley, mandarin collar, popover, long sleeve
specs.care: Machine or hand wash cold, do not bleach, low heat tumble dry or hang dry

record.description: A long-sleeve men's henley in blue, sized 3XL, from Dioufond. It features a mandarin collar, a popover design with a partial chest button placket, and a straight-cut hem. Made of 80% cotton and 20% polyester in a regular fit, it is machine or hand washable in cold water.

specs.putting surface: approx. 2 ft x 8.5 ft inside border

record.description: A 3-by-10-foot putting practice mat from JEF World of Golf, featuring a premium turf surface with roughly 2 by 8.5 feet of putting area inside the border. It includes two holes with flags and a padded rubber base, and is designed for indoor or outdoor use.

A manual-focus prime lens with a 35mm focal length and a maximum aperture of F1.2, designed for APS-C mirrorless cameras with the Canon EOS-M mount. It has a 6-element, 5-group optical design, a copper core and aluminum shell body, and a crescent-shaped focus ring. Finished in black.

Two ivory frosted plastic flameless candles, 6 inches tall and 3.25 inches across, with a flickering moving flame. Waterproof for outdoor use. Each runs on two AA batteries and comes with a remote offering 2, 4, 6, or 8 hour timers, plus flicker or steady glow and adjustable brightness. The set includes two candles and one remote.

specs.options: Long sleeve shirt or long johns

record.description: STARK SOUL men's thermal underwear set in black/blue, size L/XL, sold as a long-sleeve shirt or long johns. Made from a stretchy sports fabric with double-seamless construction, designed for autumn and winter wear during activities such as hiking, cycling, skiing, and training. Listed features include breathability, moisture absorption, and flexibility.

A 30 cm USB charging cable with a 2.0mm x 12.0mm DC plug for recharging Mini S530 Bluetooth earbuds and headphones. It can draw power from wall adapters, computer ports, power banks, and car chargers. Not compatible with B&O Earset 2 or Blue Parrot headsets, so check your plug size before ordering.

specs.fit: Designed for most cube shelving units
specs.design feature: Front tab for pulling the box out
specs.decoration: Felt dog animal appliqué on front

record.description: A 13 x 13 x 13 inch cube storage box made of 100% polyester, designed to fit most cube shelving units. It has a front tab for pulling it out and a felt dog animal appliqué on the front. Intended for kids and toddlers.

specs.insulation: Thermal insulation liner; keeps food cold for at least 7 hours with ice

record.description: 15-liter insulated lunch bag with a double-deck layout that keeps upper and lower foods separate. Its thickened, seamless PEVA liner is designed to resist leaks and wipes clean. With ice cubes added, the thermal liner is meant to keep food and drinks cold for at least seven hours. Weighing about 1.5 pounds, it suits lunches and picnics.

specs.care: Oven, microwave, freezer and dishwasher safe

record.description: A set of four stoneware rice bowls from Denby's Heritage Terrace collection, finished in a multicolor design. Made in England and handcrafted by skilled artisans, the bowls are listed as safe for oven, microwave, freezer and dishwasher use.

SmartyKat Super Scratcher Chaise is a floor cat scratcher made from corrugated cardboard, with a cradle-shaped lounge area. Catnip is infused between each layer of cardboard before the block is cut, so scent is released as your cat scratches. The corrugate texture is meant to resemble tree bark. The product is made in the USA.

specs.style: Sleeveless lace fit and flare midi dress

record.description: A sleeveless midi dress in navy with a fit-and-flare silhouette and lace construction. It has a contemporary cut that runs small, so sizing up may suit some buyers. The dress is partially lined. This listing is for size M, which corresponds to US 6-8 on the size guide provided.

A single 8.4 fl oz bottle of L'Occitane bath and shower gel with a Cherry Blossom scent. Designed for sensitive skin, it cleanses gently and leaves skin lightly perfumed. Apply to wet skin, lather, and rinse off.

specs.package dimensions: 3.12 in L x 3.12 in W x 5.06 in H

record.description: The WIX 57502XP is an automotive oil filter from the brand WIX, listed under model number 57502XP. It is made in China and ships in a package weighing 0.75 pounds, measuring about 3.12 by 3.12 by 5.06 inches.

A large nylon beach blanket measuring about 82.7 by 78.7 inches, sized for four to eight adults. It folds compactly, weighs 12 oz, and comes with a carry bag. Four built-in pockets hold small essentials, and four ground stakes help it stay put in wind. Suitable for beaches, picnics, camping, and other outdoor outings.

Sperry's Cruise boat shoe in navy and grey, sized Big Kid 5, blends a sneaker build with a dressier look. It has a leather-like upper, a lace-up closure with a 360° lacing system for a snug fit, a memory foam footbed, and a cupsole construction with a rubber outsole for traction.

specs.logo: Rubber UGG logo print on front shaft

record.description: This women's UGG Classic Short fashion boot is finished in black with a soft suede upper and a rubber UGG logo print on the front shaft. It features a 17 mm UGGpure lining and insole, plus a Treadlite by UGG outsole. Available in US women's size 8 medium.

specs.straps: Adjustable poly-webbing neck and long waist ties
specs.features: Waterproof, lightweight, wipe-clean surface

Steel construction and lag screws are included, with installation instructions.

A three-tier corner wall shelf with fan-shaped boards of distressed brown paulownia wood, hung on jute rope. Each shelf holds about 10 lbs and must be mounted in a corner to stay level. Hudson baby girl's cotton dresses in a blueberry print, sized 12-18 months. The set includes coordinating dresses made from 100% cotton, intended for everyday wear. The listing describes the fabric as soft and gentle on skin.

Four Paws Wee-Wee odor control pads with Febreze Freshness scent, 50 count, measuring 22 by 23 inches. Designed for dogs of all sizes.

specs.material: ABS plastic mount, stainless steel rod

specs.lettering: Black OVERSIZE LOAD letters, 2 inch x 12 inch

record.description: A yellow nylon mesh banner measuring 18 by 84 inches, displaying black "OVERSIZE LOAD" lettering for marking wide or oversized loads. Intended for use on equipment, boats, and modular homes, and designed to be used where oversize load marking is required.

A99 neon green floating golf practice balls, sold as a 48-piece set with a carry bag. Each ball has a two-piece build, 432 dimples, and a 90 compression rating, with an injection-molded Surlyn cover. Designed for practice in water hazards, pools, and ponds.

specs.display: LED with remaining time or running state

specs.included: bain-marie, decorating stands, baking and decorating gadgets

record.description: AMAV Toys Cake Pops Butterfinger Maker is a DIY kids' toy for ages 6 and up. The set includes a bain-marie, decorating stands, and baking and decorating gadgets, plus a color-printed recipes booklet. No food is included, and no oven is needed.

A swivel faucet aerator with a 720-degree rotating head, made of solid brass with a polished, electroplated finish. It offers three water flow settings, from soft to strong, and uses air infusion to produce a softer, less splashing stream. It is listed as fitting most round home faucets and is designed for kitchen, bathroom, and utility sink use.

Men's adidas golf shoe in grey, green, and black, size 10 US, with a regular fit and lace closure. The mesh and synthetic upper is made with Primegreen recycled materials, with at least 50% recycled content in the upper. The midsole uses Bounce cushioning with Boost in the heel.
A men's Stetson & Dobbs Carolina straw hat in natural, size XL, model OSCLNA-3832. It has an Outback-style brim and a vented crown. Listed as a men's fit.

A two-piece set of clear acrylic apothecary jars, one 15 oz and one 20 oz, for storing bathroom vanity items like cotton swabs, cotton balls, and bath salts. Each jar has a removable lid and a wide opening for easy access. The plastic resists shattering and wipes clean easily.

specs.package_contents: 1 hybrid case, 1 tempered glass screen protector

record.description: A rose gold protective case for the Samsung Galaxy On5, with a textured metal-look finish and a two-layer design that combines a rubberized inner shell with a harder outer cover. A hooded reindeer costume for dogs in Medium, designed for Christmas or other winter-themed parties. It fastens with Velcro at the neck and chest. The listing gives two different fit measurements, so confirm sizing before ordering.

A 10-piece pirate-themed toy set from Wild Republic with five pirate figures, a two-piece cannon, a treasure chest, an eye patch, and an X-marks-the-spot flag. Suited to imaginative play, dioramas, and party favors, labeled for ages 3 and up, and made without phthalates or lead.

specs.cushioning: Lightweight with gel pads in heel and forefoot

specs.upholstery: Soft polyester fabric with piped trim
specs.legs: Dark walnut stained wood with non-marking caps

A round, two-tier stainless steel lunch container in white, designed for soup and hot food. Each tier is secured with locking clips, and the lid features a twist-open design. The container is advertised as BPA free and as safe for dishwashers and freezers.

Women's large Bermuda pajama sleep shorts from HUE in a chambray blue colorway with a printed knit fabric. They have an elastic waistband, a relaxed fit, and a 10.5-inch inseam. The listing says the prints were designed by HUE's studio team in New York.

A red decal sticker for the radiator grille of the 2018 Kia Stinger, sold as one set. It is applied with adhesive double-sided tape and is described as new and made in Korea. The listing presents it as a styling accent with a 3D-designed printed finish intended to fit the grille.

A stylized vinyl collectible figure of Thor from the Avengers: Endgame film, made by Funko as part of its Pop! line. The figure stands 3.75 inches tall and is designed to be displayed alongside other Avengers Endgame Pop! figures. The listing notes that the eye paint difference is subtle.

Joyfunny My Hero Academia training sweatpants in XX-Large, Type F, styled after characters including Izuku, Froppy (Tsuyu Asui), and Ochaco Uraraka. Made of 100% cotton with a soft feel. A 9-foot round patio table umbrella in beige, with a 100% polyester canopy, eight steel ribs, and a crank lift. A push-button tilt adjusts the angle to follow the sun, and a built-in air vent improves airflow. Suited to garden, porch, and outdoor dining areas. The base is not included.

A children's flower-growing kit from Miracle-Gro that lets kids decorate a tin planter with paint, then sow Zinnia, Marigold, and Cosmo seeds in coconut fiber pucks. A walnut-colored men's hiking shoe in size 10.5 M US, made with a suede leather and mesh upper for breathability. specs.occasions: School, office, casual, dating, party, beach

record.description: A lightweight, draped open-front blazer for women in red, size Small, made from a soft rayon blend with some stretch. It suits office, school, casual outings, and parties. A 120-piece plastic fort-building set with 75 sticks about 15 inches long and 45 balls about 2 inches across, in blue and green. Pieces twist together and a carry bag is included. A bed sheet or blanket is needed for a roof or walls, and the set suits ages 5 and up.

Jessica Simpson model J5596 aviator sunglasses with a metal frame and polycarbonate lenses carrying a UV-protective coating. Men's compression base layer pants in a 92% polyester, 8% spandex blend, designed to be worn under jerseys or as tights for football, running, yoga and other sports. A men's black heavyweight car coat in a wool blend twill, sized Small, with a roomy fit through the chest and waist and a button-front closure. The listing describes the fabric as thick, warm, and soft. It is an Amazon Essentials brand product.

A pack of 12 large traditional gift bows in silver metallic foil, each about 4.5 inches in diameter. The bows have a self-adhesive backing for simple application to gifts and packaging. They are sold separately from the ribbon and banding that the listing says they coordinate with.

specs.compatibility: Bottle interchangeable with most standard 32 oz. jelly jars

Ten white 42mm festoon LED bulbs for automotive interior lighting, such as dome, map, and trunk or cargo lights. Each bulb holds 16 SMD 3528 LEDs at 6000K and is rated for 50,000 hours. A dark brown women's mid-ankle hiking boot in size 5 M US, made of leather with a rubber lug outsole for traction. The listing describes it as waterproof and offering shock-absorbing cushioning for trail use.

A men's structured baseball cap from Under Armour in Academy Blue with red accents, sized X-Large/XX-Large. It features a pre-curved visor, a low-profile classic fit, and a foam-padded front panel. Its UA Microthread fabric dries quickly and includes built-in HeatGear.

A red Daewoo countertop microwave with a 0.7 cubic foot capacity, model KOR07R3ZER. It includes a turntable to help heat food evenly. Suited to a home kitchen for reheating and cooking everyday meals.

A royal blue flower crown headband wreath from Love Sweety, handmade and about 19 cm (7.48 inches) in diameter, which the listing says fits most head sizes. It is presented as suitable for brides, bridesmaids, and flower girls, and for weddings, festivals, and photography.

A black 6000 mAh battery case for iPhone 6, 6s, 7, and 8 with a lithium-polymer battery. It starts and stops charging manually with a power button and does not include a cable. It does not support wireless charging or CarPlay, and it does not protect the screen.

specs.protection: Raised bezel around screen and camera

specs.style: Slim full-body case with raised bezels

Women's 6-inch work boot from Timberland PRO in Turkish Coffee, size 8. Features a women's last, full-grain leather upper with a waterproof membrane, and an alloy safety toe. The all-weather TPU outsole sits on a polyurethane midsole, and the footbed uses Dynamic Anti-Fatigue Technology.

A set of wide-mouthed plastic straws for thick drinks like smoothies, milkshakes, and bubble tea. record.description: Convertible winter mittens that flip into fingerless gloves via magnets, leaving fingers free for tasks like fishing, photography, or texting. Recommended for temperatures of about 20°F or warmer, not extreme cold or heavy snow.

specs.pockets: Two button-through welt pockets at rear

record.description: Men's black slim-fit, flat-front dress pants from Amazon Essentials, sized 28W x 28L. They are fitted through the hip and thigh with a tapered leg and sit below the waist. Made from polyester twill, they feature two button-through welt pockets at the rear.

specs.closure: Continuous double-slider zip with personalized puller
specs.pockets: Two pockets with invisible zip closure

specs.construction: 3 cooling mesh pairs and 3 thermal waffle pairs

A 1-1/2 inch wide sheer organza ribbon in hot red, sold as a 25-yard spool. It is made from 100% polyester and has wired edges that hold shapes for bows, curls, and floral work. specs.use: Protects floors, carpets, and furniture from paint and debris

Disposable clear plastic martini-style cups with stems, sold as a set of 30. Each cup holds about 5 ounces and comes in two pieces, a cup and a base. specs.use: Line striping athletic fields, applied upside down

Listed features include single-coat coverage and quick drying.

Gucci GG0381S 008 sunglasses with a full-rim, rectangular plastic frame in Dark Havana. The green silver mirror lenses offer 100% UV protection and are non-polarized. Measurements include a 57 mm lens width, 18 mm bridge, and 145 mm arm length.

specs.product: Eros Pour Femme Eau de Parfum

record.description: A 0.17-ounce splash bottle of Versace Eros Pour Femme, a women's eau de parfum fragrance. The compact size offers a convenient way to try the scent or carry it when travelling. Listed under Beauty & Personal Care.

specs.product line: McKay Lake Long Down Hooded Winter Jacket

record.description: A women's black long down jacket from Columbia's McKay Lake line, sized Medium. It has a hood, 650-fill-power down insulation, and a water-resistant shell. The jacket features a dual zipper, secure hand pockets, and is described as lightweight with Heatseal warmth.

specs.included: Remote transmitter, battery, 4 propellers, 4 protection rings, USB cable, manual

Reusable black silicone ear plugs sold as a three-pair set in small, medium, and large sizes. Each pair has ear hooks and an oval shape meant to fit the ear canal. A light blue denim maxi skirt in a high-rise A-line flared cut, sized XL and measuring 35 inches long. specs.style: Women's active legging with side stripe

specs.graphic: Die-cut and embossed Bar & Shield logo with script

specs.design: SL030 Smoke Skeleton I Want You

DMC Color Variations Holiday floss pack with eight multi-colored skeins of six-strand 100% cotton thread. Each skein measures 8.7 yards and has an over-dyed effect that creates shifting color along its length. Suited to embroidery and other needle crafts. Model 417XUS63.

A 85-inch 4K UHD QLED smart TV from Samsung's 2021 Q60A series, model QN85Q60AAFXZA. It uses quantum dot color, dual LED backlighting, and Quantum HDR, with a slim design, AI-based upscaling to 4K, and built-in Alexa voice assistant.

A promise ring in 18K white gold with round inlaid cubic zirconia totaling 0.04 carats. Couple set with women's size 6.5 and men's size 10.5. specs.graphic: Tribal fish design, dye sub print

record.description: A men's long sleeve fishing shirt from Columbia with a classic fit and a tribal fish graphic. The dye-sublimated graphic is described as colorfast.

specs.features: Moisture wicking, tag free, double needle hem

record.description: Gildan men's A-shirt undershirts, sold as a 5-pack in grey and black in X-Large. Solid colors are 100% cotton, while sport grey versions blend cotton and polyester. The shirts are tag-free, have a double-needle hem, and are described as moisture wicking. Colors may vary from the pictured assortment.

Men's Timex smartwatch with a 43mm silver-tone brass case and a black leather strap that adjusts to wrists up to 8 inches. Its white dial features an Indiglo backlight, and it tracks steps, distance, calories, and sleep while syncing with your phone via Bluetooth. Water resistant to 50 meters for recreational swimming only.

This New Balance kids' running shoe in black and white, size 3.5 W US Big Kid, is designed for ages 8 to 12. It features a laceless BOA dial fit system for a quick, adjustable fit. The upper combines synthetic material and mesh, the midsole uses REVlite cushioning, and the rubber outsole provides traction.

specs.features: Hood, patch pockets, belt with 2 belt loops

specs.adjustment: Adjustable seat height and armrest height

record.description: A red racing-style gaming chair with a 360-degree swivel, rocking function, and recline between 90 and 170 degrees. Seat and armrest heights are adjustable, and it includes a detachable headrest pillow and a USB-powered massage lumbar cushion. Ships with hardware and tools; the listing estimates about 20 minutes to assemble. Suitable for gaming, office, or home use.

A royal blue floor-length ball gown made of sequined tulle, featuring a sweetheart neckline, sleeveless cut, and corset lace-up back. Decorated with 3D floral appliqués, pearls, and beading. Suited to quinceañera, prom, and formal occasions. Made to order, with custom sizing based on your measurements.

specs.design: Tampa Bay football fan graphic, 'No Risk It, No Biscuit'

record.description: A short-sleeve orange youth T-shirt from Smack Apparel, made of 100% cotton and screen printed in the USA. It is pre-shrunk and machine washable. The front carries a Tampa Bay football fan graphic reading "No Risk It, No Biscuit." The listing is for a youth Medium, with a size range of Small to 5X.

specs.connectivity: USB receiver or Bluetooth Low Energy

record.description: The Logitech R500 is a wireless presentation remote with a laser pointer, connecting by USB receiver or Bluetooth Low Energy. It works with Windows, Mac, iOS, Android, and presentation software, reaching up to 20 meters. One AAA battery is rated for about 12 months, and the USB receiver stores in a dock. This model is discontinued.

A chrome tub spout from Delta's Peerless line, model RP4370, designed to fit Delta faucets with a pull-out diverter for a hand shower. It connects to standard 1/2-inch or 3/4-inch pipe. The listing describes it as made to original specifications and tested for quality performance.

A two-piece silver gift set from Zebra, featuring a stainless steel mechanical pencil with 0.7mm HB lead and a ballpoint pen with 0.8mm black ink, both with fine points. The knurled grip is designed to help with a secure hold, and the retractable plunger operates quietly.

A king-size white quilted heated mattress pad from Sunbeam, made of 100% polyester. It has dual side controllers, each offering 10 heat settings, operated through the SleekSet controls. specs.vehicle fit: Sedans, hatchbacks, minivans, SUVs (see manufacturer site for fit)

record.description: A black three-bike trunk carrier from Allen Sports, arriving fully assembled for quick installation. It folds flat for storage and suits most sedans, hatchbacks, minivans, and SUVs; check the manufacturer's site for exact fit.

specs.wear options: Four ways: off shoulder, with shoulder, one shoulder, strapless

record.description: A burgundy floor-length maxi dress in US size 12, with an off-the-shoulder neckline and an elastic-lined top. It has an empire waist with ruching, a side split, and layered ruffles. The dress can be worn four ways: off the shoulder, with straps on the shoulder, one shoulder, or strapless.

A men's quartz wristwatch with a wooden case and stainless steel bracelet band, made by BOBO BIRD. specs.design: Frank Lloyd Wright Luxfer Prism inspired

Its 13 MP main rear camera pairs with a 5 MP super wide lens, and a 5 MP front camera offers portrait mode. A 3,000 mAh battery powers it. It is listed for Verizon, AT&T, T-Mobile, Metro, and Cricket.

specs.rotation: 360 degrees, adjustable to a fixed angle

record.description: Cricut Joy accessory bundle for beginners, including a padded storage tote, a three-piece tool set (weeder, spatula, scraper), three 0.4mm fine-point pens in green, red, and violet, a replacement blade, and a digital guide to Cricut Smart Materials emailed to the buyer. The blade is for use with Cricut Joy machines and the blade housing, sold separately.

A gold-toned necklace from MEVECCO featuring a small hammered-finish evil eye pendant and a cubic zirconia accent. The chain measures 16.5 inches with a 2-inch extension, and the piece is plated in 14K gold over brass. It weighs about 4 grams and comes packaged in a gift box.

A pink Himalayan salt lamp from The Body Source, hand-carved from natural salt and set on a neem wood base. It has an integrated dimmer switch for adjusting the glow, arrives fully assembled, and includes a spare 15-watt bulb. Each lamp has a distinctive shape and is roughly 6 to 8 inches tall.

specs.compatibility: Gas, electric, and propane camping stoves

record.description: A white stovetop espresso maker, or Moka pot, from GROSCHE's Milano line, with a 9.3 oz capacity serving six espresso cups. Made from food-grade anodized aluminum with a silicone gasket, it works on gas, electric, and propane stoves but not induction. Hand washing is recommended.

A men's adidas Originals X_PLR sneaker in a White Tint, Black and White colorway, size 9. It has a knit upper and mesh lining, a nubuck heel with 3-stripe webbing tape, an OrthoLite sockliner, and a speed lacing system.

Two pairs of 5 mm square stud earrings set with cubic zirconia, one white and one black. Their magnetic closure eliminates the need for a traditional post, so they suit both pierced and unpierced ears. Stainless steel construction is presented as resistant to corrosion and rust, and the design is marketed for men and women alike.

These Roamans white Bermuda shorts in a size 3X have a relaxed, pull-on fit with an elasticized waistband and side pockets. Made from a cotton-polyester knit with a 12-inch inseam, they are machine washable and imported.

A 10-inch pink silicone whisk from GorGin with a stainless steel handle that has a hanging hole. The wire is coated in food-grade silicone, which is designed to be heat resistant and easy to clean. It can be used for blending, whisking, beating, and stirring while cooking or baking. Sold as a single pack.

A rose red women's trifold wallet made of soft synthetic leather with a snap closure. It has a bowknot design with a small cat charm, 13 card slots (two of them clear photo slots), a bill compartment, and a kiss-lock coin pocket. Measures 4.21 by 3.18 by 1.41 inches.

specs.feature: Hinged storage with padded seat top

record.description: A grey tufted storage bench measuring 17" high, 38" wide, and 16" deep. It has a hardwood frame and bonded-leather upholstery, with crystal-like tufted accents in a traditional style. The padded top works as seating or a footrest, and the interior provides hinged storage. Suitable for an entryway, living room, or the foot of a bed.

record.description: Ohuhu adhesive-backed vinyl set with 60 sheets in 30 shades, each 12 by 12 inches, plus 10 transfer tape sheets. A women's full-zip fleece jacket in Columbia Navy, size X-Small. Made of 100% polyester MTR filament fleece, it has a collared neck, a full-zip closure, and two side zippered pockets. The modern classic fit has an active cut, and the jacket is designed for cold-weather wear.

A rechargeable electric toothbrush for adults from Sporzin, with five modes and three intensity levels. It offers an 8mm swing amplitude, about 40,000 vibrations per minute, and a two-minute timer that prompts area changes every 30 seconds. Medium-soft W-shaped bristles come with a protective cover, and it charges over USB.

A package of six bundles of live Giant Hairgrass (Eleocharis vivipara), a freshwater aquarium plant suited to background cover in fish tanks. Plants typically reach roughly 5 to 10 inches in height. A cream micro-fleece wearable blanket for big kids in size 2/3T, featuring a dog graphic and a TOG rating of 1.0. The sack design is meant to be worn over regular sleepwear in place of loose blankets. It has foot openings for walking and room to tuck feet in at night.

specs.design: Star Trek TNG printed novelty design

record.description: Star Trek: The Next Generation novelty pajama set from CafePress in dark colors. The crewneck top and relaxed-fit bottoms are made of 100% cotton, with a no-fly string waist. Plaid and lumberjack-print bottoms are cotton flannel with side pockets; other styles are cotton jersey. Marketed as a unisex set.

specs.cushioning: Full-length EVA insert with Poron foam under forefoot
specs.construction: Handsewn upper stitched to midsole, cemented to outsole

specs.seat_dimensions: 45.00 W x 23.50 D x 17.75 H inches

A medium unisex crewneck sweatshirt in maroon, featuring a white-ink screen-printed Hawkins Middle School AV Club design. Made from a 50/50 blend and printed in the USA. The listing notes that it typically runs large for women, and it is presented as a gift option.

A 72-inch black steel storage cabinet on four detachable rubber casters, two of which lock. It has four adjustable shelves, a built-in lock with two keys, and a powder-coated finish. Rated for 600 lbs total, 120 lbs per shelf. Assembly is required, using tools.

A long-sleeved grey infant bodysuit in a cotton blend, sized 0-3 months. It has an expandable neckline and snap closure at the bottom for easier diaper changes, and carries a playful printed slogan. Hand wash or machine washable.

A limited edition Moleskine notebook with a hard cover, measuring 5 by 8.25 inches, with ruled pages totaling 240. It has an elastic closure band and inner storage folders. Navy mesh slip-on first walker shoes for infants, sized 12-18 months. specs.card storage: 3 card slots and a cash slot

record.description: A leather-look wallet case for the iPhone 11, 11 Pro, and 11 Pro Max, with a One Piece Sabo anime design. It has a TPU inner shell with a PU leather exterior, three card slots and a cash slot, and a fold-out stand for viewing. Cutouts provide access to buttons, camera, speaker, and connector. One case is included.

specs.window type: Casement, bottom-hung, and skylight windows (not sliding)
specs.installation: Adhesive hook tape and Velcro, no drilling
specs.use: Seals side gaps around portable AC exhaust hose or tumble dryer vent

record.description: A white nylon seal for portable air conditioner and tumble dryer hoses, sized at 400 cm. It suits casement, bottom-hung, and skylight windows but not sliding ones. Adhesive hook tape and Velcro hold it in place without drilling. The zippered design closes around the hose to limit warm air flowing back inside. Washable, water resistant, and removable.

specs.material: Absorbent polyester fabric with waterproof backing

record.description: A 19 by 24 inch dish drying mat in Surf Green, made of absorbent polyester fabric with a waterproof, slip-resistant backing. At 0.13 inches thick, it lies low on the counter. It is machine washable (do not bleach), made in the USA, free of phthalates and BPA, and contains over 50% recycled fibers.

A solar charger for Suntek-series trail cameras, mountable to trees, poles, or Moultrie tripods. It outputs 9 V at up to 800 mA from a built-in lithium polymer battery, with overload and overdischarge protection. Rated IP65 and suited to indoor or outdoor use.

Men's black athletic shorts in X-Large by Russell Athletic. Made from breathable mesh with Dri-Power moisture-wicking technology. Features an elastic waistband with an internal draw cord for adjustable fit, side pockets for small items, and a 9-inch inseam.

A white, long-sleeve ribbed knit pullover from Romwe with an asymmetrical cross-wrap neckline and a slim fit. Made of a blend of polyester, cotton, and spandex for stretch. Plain solid styling pairs easily with pants, shorts, skirts, or jeans. Sizing runs small, so consult the size chart before ordering. Machine wash with like colors.

specs.type: Clip-on heel wheels for regular shoes
specs.lighting: LEDs in wheels light up as they turn, no batteries

record.description: Clip-on heel wheels that convert regular shoes into roller skates, designed for children ages 6 and up. The wheels contain LEDs that light up as they spin, requiring no batteries. Adjustable fit, a rubber strap, and larger brakes are included. Maximum user weight is 132 lbs. Dark blue.

White matte graphic art tape for drawing crisp, even lines on charts, crafts, decorations, and signage. Its permanent adhesive suits indoor and outdoor use on clean, dry plastic, whiteboard, glass, paper, wood, metal, or ceramic. Supplied as one roll, made in the USA.

specs.assembled_dimensions: 54.53 L x 29.92 W x 18.90 H inches
specs.certification: JPMA certified, meets or exceeds CPSC and ASTM safety standards

record.description: A wooden toddler bed themed with Nick Jr. PAW Patrol for children from 15 months and up. Two high side rails help keep little ones safe during the move to a big kid bed. The bed is JPMA certified to meet or exceed CPSC and ASTM safety standards and is easy to assemble.

specs.care: Machine wash cold on gentle; tumble dry; cool iron if needed

record.description: Two ivory sheer curtain panels with a soft, textured linen-look finish, each measuring 52 by 84 inches with eight silver grommets. The sheer fabric lets light through while offering some privacy and airflow. Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle, tumble dry, and do not bleach.

A compact 11 by 14 inch magnetic whiteboard with a light aluminum frame and a clean look that suits many rooms. Its dry erase surface works for notes and lists, and magnets let you pin up photos or reminders. Mounting hardware and a marker with an eraser are included, and it hangs either way.

specs.care: Hand wash, air dry; not for microwave, oven, or dishwasher

record.description: A 12-piece set of reusable zip-lock bags made from transparent PEVA plastic, described as BPA-free and PVC-free. The set includes five sandwich bags, five snack bags, and two larger bags, plus two blue sealing clips. Suitable for packing lunches, snacks, and fruit or freezing food. Hand wash and air dry; not for use in microwaves, ovens, or dishwashers.

A 7-pack of long-sleeve bodysuits for baby girls, size 18 months, in an assorted pack. Features snap closures, which the listing describes as strong enough to hold up to repeated wear and washing. Color is not specified.

specs.key_ingredients: Saberry amla fruit extract, proline, glycine, plant proteins
specs.antioxidant_blend: White tea extract (Oxyphyte) with hyaluronic acid
specs.free_from: Dairy, gluten, soy, nuts, eggs, artificial flavors, sweeteners, colors

record.description: A vanilla plant-based protein powder marketed to support collagen production, with amla fruit extract, proline, glycine, plant ceramides and white tea extract. Certified non-GMO, gluten-free, dairy-free and vegan-friendly, it weighs 11.43 oz and is free of soy, nuts and eggs.

Six refill bulbs from Bath & Body Works in the Sweet Cinnamon Pumpkin scent, packed as three twin-packs. The fragrance combines spicy pumpkin puree with sweet butter and vanilla cream. The bulbs are made to fit Wallflower fragrance plugs and night-lights. This scent is listed as discontinued.

specs.origin: Eastern European countries (e.g., Russia, Romania, Croatia, Serbia, Ukraine)
specs.contents: Candy, cookies, chocolates, wafers, biscuits, pretzels, and more

record.description: An assorted snack box of pre-packaged treats from Eastern European countries, sold by WorldWideTreats. Contents vary by box but may include candy, cookies, chocolates, wafers, biscuits, and pretzels. Each box holds at least eight snacks, and the photos show example items rather than the exact contents. Prime shipping is available.

specs.included: 1 knob, 3 rubber adapters, 1 hex spanner, 4 metal screws
specs.fitment: Manual and automatic vehicles without shift button

record.description: A black resin and aluminum alloy skull-themed gear shift knob, sized about 98mm by 40mm. It comes with three rubber adapters for 8mm, 10mm, and 12mm shifter diameters, plus a hex spanner and four screws. Intended for manual and automatic vehicles without a shift button; not suitable for reverse-pull shifters, buttoned shifters, or shifters that cannot be replaced.

Ivory faux plastic pearls with no holes, in 200 pieces: 20 at 20mm, 60 at 14mm, and 120 at 10mm. The kit includes 6 packets of transparent water gels that make the pearls float in vases. Suited to table scatter and vase filling for weddings, showers, and other events. Reusable.

specs.product type: Travel system with bassinet stroller and infant car seat
specs.stroller configurations: 3 in 1: infant bassinet, infant car seat carrier, toddler stroller
specs.seat pad cleaning: Spot clean with mild soap and warm water
specs.car seat attachment: Click Connect one-step attachment to stroller frame

record.description: This Graco travel system bundles a bassinet-style stroller with a SnugRide SnugLock 35 infant car seat in the Wynton pattern. The stroller converts into three setups: a bassinet, a car seat carrier, and a toddler stroller, offering nine riding options. The car seat clicks onto the stroller frame in one step, and the seat pad can be spot cleaned.

specs.included: Tray only; flower box not included

record.description: A white plastic tray sized to hold a 24-inch flower box, measuring 22.25 by 6.5 by 1 inch. Made in the USA from lightweight, fade-resistant plastic, it is intended to protect decks, patios, or indoor surfaces beneath a flower box. Only the tray is included; the flower box is not.

specs.material: Steel with rust resistant plastic coating
specs.design: Snug fit arms for cabinet shelves

record.description: A light blue medium undershelf basket from Smart Design for cabinets and pantries. It uses snug-fit arms to sit on a shelf, creating a second level of storage above and below the shelf. The steel wire frame has a rust-resistant plastic coating. Measures about 16 by 10.25 by 5.5 inches and weighs 12 ounces.

A gold-toned heart locket pendant measuring 0.75 by 0.5 inches, with room for up to two photos. It is 24k gold plated, sold with or without an 18-inch curb link chain, and comes in a black velvet pouch. The brand states it is made in the USA and backs the piece with a lifetime replacement guarantee.

The Kaweco Brass Sport is a fountain pen with a brass body and a fine nib of 23 K gold-plated steel. It weighs 21 g and measures 13 cm with the cap posted and 10.5 cm with the cap closed. The pen is made by hand with individual inspection in Nuremberg, Germany.

specs.type: Volume lash extensions, easy fan, self-fanning

record.description: Blue volume lash extensions in a 0.07mm thickness and 14-20mm length, designed as self-fanning clusters for quicker application. The lashes are supplied with a pre-treated glue base at the root and are offered in red, green, brown, blue, and purple. Intended for professional salons and training schools.

A 24 x 4.5 inch wall-mounted coat rack in weathered white, built from distressed wood with five metal hooks. It holds up to 30 lbs and comes with mounting hardware for installation. Suited to hanging hats, coats, bags, and umbrellas in spaces such as kitchens, bedrooms, and bathrooms, with a rustic style.

specs.load capacity: 200 pounds or more when installed properly
specs.compatible items: Fishing, chest, waist, hunting, and duck hunting waders; wader boots
specs.use: Drying waders and keeping them off the ground

record.description: A stainless steel hanger for drying fishing and hunting waders. It is made from 1/4-inch steel and is designed to hold chest waders, waist waders, and wader boots off the ground. The listing states a load capacity of 200 pounds or more when installed properly.

specs.exterior: Bonded fleece with grid knit texture
specs.logo: Embroidered Spyder logo on front and label on back

record.description: A men's full-zip jacket from Spyder made of 100% polyester. It has a bonded fleece exterior with a grid knit texture and a Sherpa fleece lining. The jacket closes with a full zip and includes two side zipper pockets. An embroidered Spyder logo sits on the front, with a label on the back.

specs.product dimensions: 23 in high x 16 in wide x 25 in long

record.description: The Pet Gear Easy Step III is a chocolate-colored pet stair made from blow molded plastic with a carpet tread. It is designed for small, medium, and large dogs and measures 23 inches high, 16 inches wide, and 25 inches long. The carpet tread can be removed for cleaning.

specs.functions: Black and red ballpoint, 0.5mm pencil, stylus, eraser

record.description: A personalized multifunction pen with a satin black finish and chrome accents. It twists between black and red ballpoint refills and a 0.5mm pencil, and includes a stylus and a hidden eraser. Custom engraving of up to 25 characters is included, and the pen carries a lifetime mechanical warranty. Weighs 0.7 oz with a 1.8 cm barrel width.

A black short-sleeve t-shirt in an X-Large size, sold in sizes Small through 5X, with a Raider football fan graphic reading "Raider True 'Til The Day I'm Through." The shirt is 100% cotton, screen printed in the USA, and pre-shrunk for machine washing. The design is the copyrighted intellectual property of Smack Apparel Inc.

specs.footbed: Soft EVA with anatomical arch support

record.description: Reef RF002345 sandal in aqua/green, sized 11/12 M US Little Kid. Features a vegan leather upper strap with jersey lining, a soft EVA footbed with arch support, a flexible triple-density EVA midsole, and a molded high-density EVA outsole for traction.

specs.features: Mesh underarm inserts, sweat-wicking Climalite fabric

record.description: A white short-sleeve crewneck jersey from adidas in the Real Madrid home design for the 2019-20 season. Its regular fit runs wider through the body, and it is made from recycled polyester with mesh underarm panels and sweat-wicking Climalite fabric. A woven club crest sits on the front.
The Hyperkin HDTV Cable connects a Sega Saturn to HDTVs and is listed as compatible with all Saturn models. It supports 720p resolution and measures 7 feet. A 6-foot Micro cable is included.

specs.included: Two replacement lenses, frame not included

record.description: Replacement lenses for Oakley Holbrook sunglasses, sold by Lens Swap, in a dark silver mirror finish with 6% light transmission. Each lens is 1.4 mm thick, polarized, and provides UV protection, and the listing states they meet ANSI Z80.3 standards. They fit model numbers starting with OO9102 in a 55 mm size. Two lenses are included; the frame is not.

specs.footbed: Molded EVA with arch support, heel cup, and toe bar

record.description: A poppy-colored thong sandal from Bionica, sized 9 B(M) US. It features fabric straps, a soft nubuck toe post, and a molded EVA footbed with arch support, a heel cup, and a toe bar. A shock-absorbing EVA midsole and a durable, flexible, slip-resistant rubber outsole complete the design.

A jumbo pet bowl from JW Pet Company, sold in assorted colors, with a rubber base intended to grip slippery floors. Its heavyweight construction is meant to limit sliding on tile and linoleum. The bowl is dishwasher safe and is suited to extra large breed dogs.

specs.mounting: Ready to frame or hang with poster mounts, clips, push pins, or thumb tacks

record.description: An officially licensed LEGO Batman wall poster from Trends International, measuring 22.375 by 34 inches and sold unframed. It is printed on FSC-certified gloss poster paper using high-resolution artwork. The poster can be framed or hung with clips, push pins, thumb tacks, or poster mounts, making it suitable for bedrooms, kids' rooms, dorms, and other spaces.

A three-pack of sleeveless toddler boys' tank tops in size 3T, from the Simple Joys by Carter's line. Each tank features a ribbed neckline and a pocket detail. The set comes in blue striped, orange gator, and gray striped patterns, and is sold tag-less in packaging.

specs.shipping: Sold and shipped flat in pallet quantities

record.description: A kraft double-wall corrugated Gaylord bottom measuring 48 by 40 by 36 inches, sold as a pack of 75. Made from 275-pound double-wall ECT-48 corrugated board, it suits consolidating multiple pieces and packing bulky or irregularly shaped items. Compatible with lid stock number BGAYLORDLIDHD. Shipped flat by the pallet.

specs.charging: External USB charging port with built-in cable (power bank not included)
specs.compartments: 2 main zippered compartments, 1 front zipper pocket with anti-theft buckle

record.description: A black men's sling bag crafted from water-resistant PU leather with adjustable nylon straps. It has two main compartments and a front zip pocket with anti-theft buckle, plus a USB charging port with built-in cable and an earphone hole. Suits travel, cycling, and everyday carry. Power bank not included.

specs.design: older woman and young girl holding hands, seated on gray bench
specs.packaging: fitted gift box with enclosure card
specs.care: dust with soft brush or cloth

record.description: A hand-painted resin figure from the Willow Tree line, standing 5.5 inches tall, shows an older woman and a young girl in cream dresses holding hands on a gray bench. Designed by Susan Lordi, it arrives in a fitted gift box with a card and suits a shelf, table, or mantel.

specs.key features: Replaceable wire cutters, spring-action scissors, one-hand opening

record.description: The Leatherman Surge multitool (model 7247965) is a heavy-duty stainless steel tool with 21 tools, including replaceable wire cutters and spring-action scissors. It opens one-handed, has locking tools, and comes in a nylon sheath with a lanyard ring. The listing states a 25-year warranty and manufacture in Portland, Oregon.

specs.sizing: Select by bust size per size chart

record.description: A white women's short-sleeve chef's coat with a double-breasted front closed by 10 buttons, sold with a matching chef hat made from the same cloth. The hat fastens with Velcro and is listed as fitting sizes XS to XXL. Choose the size using the bust measurement in the size chart.

Black 3mm neoprene diving gloves in size M, fitting palm widths of 3.15 to 3.54 inches, for men, women, or kids. An adjustable velcro strap and anti-slip palm suit kayaking and snorkeling. Not fully waterproof; wear with a wetsuit and hand wash in cool water.

specs.care: Machine wash cold, tumble dry low

record.description: WallFlower women's juniors denim shortalls in Belle, size Small. Features a 3-inch cuffed inseam, adjustable straps, a center-front zipper closure, and multiple pockets. Made with denim and LYCRA. Machine wash cold and tumble dry low.

specs.power requirement: No external drivers or power needed

record.description: A space gray USB-C multiport hub (model CB-C31) with four USB 3.0 ports for data up to 5Gbps. Its USB-C port passes through up to 60W of power to a compatible laptop. Built in an aluminum alloy unibody. Listed as compatible with various MacBook, Chromebook, Surface, and Windows laptops; confirm your port supports data and power delivery.

An official Alex Grey poster titled "Oversoul," printed to 18 by 24 inches and described as museum quality. The artwork is a visionary piece by the artist, presented as a wall print for home décor. The listing notes that human consciousness serves as a bridge between planetary and cosmic consciousness.

A foldable camp rocking chair from ALPS Mountaineering in a Deep Sea/Charcoal colorway. It has a powder-coated steel frame and TechMesh fabric seat, weighs 11 lbs, and measures 22" W x 17" D x 31" H. The low-profile rocker locks in place, and it supports up to 300 lbs. A shoulder bag is included for carrying.

Two D-size batteries from Trick or Treat Studios, licensed by Universal Studios and themed to Child's Play 2. Described as an accessory for the Good Guys doll, based on onscreen and behind-the-scenes reference shots. Pack contains two batteries.
